name: fantasy
description: A projection engine and draft optimiser for **Imperial Immortals 2026** (ESPN): 14-team, full-PPR, snake, no keepers, `QB / 2RB / 2WR / TE / FLEX / K / DST` starters over a 15-man roster. Head-to-head, 14 regular-season weeks, six of fourteen teams reach a three-week bracket.
